Frames 6-7: the arm on the black tee enters from the left edge, which is plausible. Lands accurately (SSIM 0.945).

veo-3.1-lite.notes: Frames 2-3 of 8 (0.8-1.6s): the glyph wall cross-dissolves in over the room, and the two standing women and the man on the left go see-through. Glyphs are mushy around frames 4-5 and settle by frame 6. Prop artifact at frames 4-7: a long white ribbon stretches out from the cube's base and shrinks back to the small white object only at the end.

veo-3.1-lite.notes: Invents a 'YOUR HOROSCOPE / HBMDS JOURNEY' title and purple orbit rings on the screen, then dissolves them away over frames 7-8 of 8 (3.3-4.0s) to match the hero, a visible on-screen morph. The girl in white leaves a little abruptly between frames 1 and 2. Lighting is spot on.

kling-v3.0-std.notes: Best 'cool' moment in the set: the woman in the coat walks toward the lens and passes it with her face intact (frames 2-3 of 8), then the camera slips through the green-cap/red-cap crowd. Docked because the screen swaps content twice in frames 3-6: a red/magenta globe, then a blue ring, then the final constellation. That reads as AI rather than UI animation. The top-left title is stable.

The woman in the coat walks at the lens and passes it at frames 2-3 with her face intact. The hoodie and striped-shirt guys stay consistent through the crowd. Only nit: the planet labels are softer than the hero (they read clearly when the photo takes over); the end is well aligned.

veo-3.1-lite.notes: Frames 2-4 of 8 (0.75-2.0s): a dark figure appears from nowhere on the right, translucent and motion-smeared, then walks off; the trio smears into a ghosted blur. kling-v3.0-std.notes: Strongest clip. The man in black with arms crossed stays coherent while the camera passes him (frames 3-5 of 8); the woman exits left cleanly.
